explication: Create is a Minecraft mod for player-designed mechanical automation, building, and decoration. The principal workflow is that a player assembles moving contraptions from blocks; the runtime captures and moves structures, with mounted storage preserving inventories. Distinct branches cover kinetic machinery, fluids and item processing, logistics, and trains. Registration and mounted-storage APIs provide a useful internal layer. The README also describes Ponder visual documentation, but no implementation path for it is present in the supplied tree. Relationships are limited to README statements and the sampled source/index references; unsampled subsystem links are omitted where uncertain.
